# B313 NEXT STEP PLAN

## B314 primary objective
Build a controlled "causal scar / recovery" developmental experiment over the existing B285+B299+AdaptivePolicy chain.

The next step should not add a new learner. It should make strongly verified negative experiences capable of entering autobiographical consolidation when causal confidence is high enough, while preventing weak or ambiguous negative events from poisoning identity.

## Secondary tracks
- real Android/Termux benchmark;
- 64–128 autonomous evaluation cycles after positive vs negative learning;
- targeted verification closure for the critical decision path;
- inspect and retire any remaining policy-like duplicate paths.

## Stop conditions
A B314 result is only considered stronger if:
- negative verified experiences can create bounded lasting change;
- recovery can reverse or appropriately attenuate the scar;
- B296 lesion remains causal;
- personality/policy changes survive restart;
- no duplicate learner/memory owner is created.
